scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@greiva/shared && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/domain && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/sync && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/application
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/api && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/collaboration && npm run build --workspace=@greiva/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n client,api,collaboration "npm run dev -w @greiva/client" "npm run dev -w @greiva/api" "npm run dev -w @greiva/collaboration"
scripts.dev:container: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n client,api,collaboration "npm run dev:container -w @greiva/client" "npm run dev -w @greiva/api" "npm run dev -w @greiva/collaboration"
scripts.desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run tauri --workspace=@greiva/client -- dev -- --locked
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:servers && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run build:servers && playwright test
scripts.test:crash: cargo build --locked --manifest-path apps/client/src-tauri/crates/page-store/Cargo.toml --example store-driver --features crash-test-hooks --target-dir .data/crash-target && node scripts/test-structured-e2e.mjs --crash
scripts.build:servers: npm run build -w @greiva/api && npm run build -w @greiva/collaboration
